d: Could an India-born executive take charge of NVIDIA? Following reports of Jensen Huang's dramatic exit, Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian has emerged as a potential contender to lead the world's leading AI chipmaker. Born in Kerala, Kurian brings decades of technology leadership and experience in AI infrastructure. Other Indian-origin executives, including Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra and Palo Alto Networks chief Nikesh Arora, are also being linked to the succession debate. Meanwhile, reports of Huang potentially returning have added another twist. Who could lead NVIDIA next? Gursshheen Gahllen…
